summary: Full-stack testing of new Inventory (Rekap Stok) + Market Indicators + Home visual redesign. Backend: 11 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_inventory_market.py all PASS (Market: shape + editable flags + live fields + PUT persistence; Inventory: CRUD, search, stats totals in/out, 404 branches). Frontend (mobile 390x844): Home logo renders intact inside white badge, header shows 'Financial Management' with NO 'Solusindo', Indikator Pasar horizontal strip shows all 5 indicators (bi_rate, inflation, sbn10y, gold, jci); tapping indicator-bi_rate opens the detail sheet, 'Perbarui nilai' (edit-indicator-bi_rate) reveals value/asof inputs, Simpan (save-indicator-btn) persists and the strip reflects the new value + as_of on re-open. ai-tips-card, account-personal-card & account-business-card render with values. More/Lainnya tab no longer shows the decorative brand/logo card ('HENZA FINTECH' text = 0 occurrences on More screen); menu-inventory row navigates to /inventory. Inventory screen shows 4 stat cards, add-inventory-btn opens form, inventory-name-input + inventory-qty-input + save-inventory-btn creates an item that appears in the list, inventory-search-input filters, tapping row opens edit sheet, delete-inventory-btn (with window.confirm on web) removes item and stats refresh. Deprecated packages detected: shadow* style props and props.pointerEvents warnings remain (same as previous iterations - not introduced by this batch).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Present across the app. Not new to this batch.
Deprecation: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - likely from react-native-draglist internals.

action_items: (Deferred from iter 3/4) Migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and drop props.pointerEvents where possible across the codebase.

(Optional/UX) In inventory.tsx edit sheet, consider adding a testID on the delete confirmation button used for native platform; web path uses window.confirm which cannot be scripted through data-testid but IS auto-accepted in Playwright via page.on('dialog', d.accept()).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py inventory CRUD: correctly uses UUID id, excludes _id via projection, defaults entry_date to today, 404 on update/delete. Clean.
server.py /api/inventory/stats: iterates entire inventory collection (up to 5000) each call; fine for expected sizes but could be optimized with aggregate pipeline if the collection grows.

server.py market_indicators: sensible pattern — asyncio.to_thread wraps blocking requests.get to Yahoo with 5s timeout; DB fallback via market_config; upserts live values so subsequent calls remain warm even when Yahoo is temporarily blocked. Editable manual keys (bi_rate/inflation/sbn10y) always return from cfg. Good.
server.py MarketConfigIn PUT: correctly filters None fields before $set with upsert=True, avoiding accidental clearing of live_asof/jci_value/gold_value. Confirmed via test_put_config_persists.

home.tsx MarketStrip + IndicatorSheet: value/asof state resets via useEffect on indicator change; save mutation invalidates ['market'] and closes sheet. Editable branch only rendered when indicator.editable is true. Clean.
home.tsx: 'Solusindo' text confirmed removed; brandSub shows 'Financial Management' only. Logo uses resizeMode='contain' as prop (correct, not style).
more.tsx: decorative brandCard was removed as required; styles (brandCard/logoBadge/logo/brandName/brandTag) remain in StyleSheet but are unused — safe to prune later.
inventory.tsx: Platform-aware confirmation (window.confirm on web) is implemented (line 133-143). Good pattern.
inventory.tsx: KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView with keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled' correctly wraps the modal body — save & delete buttons stay reachable.

All required testIDs present: indicator-<key>, edit-indicator-<key>, indicator-value-input, indicator-asof-input, save-indicator-btn, ai-tips-card, account-personal-card, account-business-card, menu-inventory, add-inventory-btn, inventory-name-input, inventory-qty-input, inventory-entry-input, inventory-exit-input, save-inventory-btn, delete-inventory-btn, inventory-search-input, inventory-row-<id>.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (home hero + market strip + indicator edit + more menu + inventory CRUD + search + delete)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create/delete their own TEST_ items and clean up in test_delete_and_404. UI test created and then deleted 'UI_TEST_Gula'. bi_rate/inflation/sbn10y values were updated by tests (final UI test restored bi_rate=5.00, asof='Agu 2026'; inflation left at 4.2 and sbn10y left at 7.5 from tests — main agent may want to reset these to original defaults 3.19 / 7.34 if the seeded values matter for demos).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/inventory[/{id}/stats] and /api/market/[indicators|config] are fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_inventory_market.py — 11 tests. Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_inventory_market.py -v -o addopts='' (the -o addopts='' disables xdist so class state persists between test methods). Frontend testIDs for both features are wired and were exercised on mobile viewport (390x844). Yahoo Finance is reachable from the container in this environment so gold+jci returned numeric values with change_pct; if not, backend gracefully falls back to cached values from db.market_config. bi_rate value in DB was left at 5.00 after UI test restore.
rca_of_issue: No functional bugs in the new features. All backend + frontend acceptance criteria pass.
